name: Rabbit Android Designed for Love: Mission One
source:
"Rabbit Android Designed for Love: Mission One" is a visual novella about love conveyed through mechanical body horror and conversations with a polite cultist. 

[From [url=https://fivebirdsmakinggames.itch.io/rabbit-android-designed-for-love-mission-one]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《为爱而设计的兔子机器人：使命一》是一部视觉中篇小说，讲述了通过机械身体恐怖和与礼貌的邪教徒的对话来传达爱的故事。

[来自[url=https://fivebirdsmakinggames.itch.io/rabbit-android-designed-for-love-mission-one]itch.io[/url]]
